subject: mathematics
concept: Designing and conducting a simple simulation to estimate the probability of a real-world event
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Using Models) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student designs a simple simulation (using physical objects like coins/counters) to model a real-world probability scenario
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a real-world scenario to an appropriate simple simulation tool
exercise.abstract: Student explains how their simulation results estimate the real-world event's probability

assessment.mastery_threshold: simulation design is logically appropriate for the real-world event being modeled
misconception_flags: designs a simulation with no genuine logical connection to the real-world event being estimated

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
